signIn.title: Start playing
signIn.intro: Choose a name, pass the human check, and you're in.
signIn.nameHint: 3 to 20 characters: Latin or Devanagari letters, digits, spaces, _ or -
signIn.humanCheckFailed: The human check did not load. Check your connection and reload the page.
signIn.guestNote: A guest account has no password. Clearing this browser's cookies loses it.
signIn.pendingCode: After you sign in you'll go straight to table {{code}}.

lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.quickPlayHint: Sit at a public table that has room
lobby.createPrivateHint: Send friends a code or a link
lobby.noTables: No public tables right now. Quick Play opens a new one.

errors.bad-name: That name is not allowed: 3 to 20 letters (Latin or Devanagari), digits, spaces, _ or -.
errors.turnstile-failed: The human check failed. Try again.
errors.too-many-guests: Too many new guests from this address. Try again later.
errors.malformed: Something went wrong with the request.
errors.too-many-guesses: Too many code guesses. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.too-many-tables: Too many private tables created. Try again later.
errors.still-leaving-previous-table: Still finishing your round at the other table. Try again in a moment.
errors.no-session: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.not-at-a-table: You are not at a table.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.

notices.loggedOut: Logged out. A new guest is a new account, with fresh chips.
notices.paused: The table stopped: {{reason}}. Chips are as last saved.

play.checkPublished: Same commitment as shown before betting
play.checkFaces: Seed gives the same shells and winner
